content: Qayeelenne Aabeele
Addaamey ba machcho Hewaanira aqiin iza shaarada attuma naa yeladus; «GODAY tana maaddiin attuma naa demmadis» gashe iza Qayeele ga sunththadus.
Qasse iza isha Aabeelekka yeladus.
Aabeeli dorsa heenththanchcha; Qayeeley biitta goshshanchcha.
Undenna wodeppe guye Qayeeley ba gaden mokkida kaththaafe Godaas yarsho shiishshides.
Gido attiin Aabeeli ba dorsata giddon koyro yelettida laaqqatappe issaa ekki shukkidi ashozappe handaza yarshides; GODAY Aabeelenne iza yarshoza ekkides.
Qayeelenne iza yarsho ekkibeenna; hessa gishshas Qayeeley keehi yiillotides; ba ayfesokka iissides.
Histtiin GODAY Qayeele, «Ays yiillotay? Ne ayfesoy ays dhumidee?
Ne lo7o ooththidaa gididaakko Xoossi ne yarsho ekkenneeshin? Neni lo7o ooththontta ixxiko nagaray ne karen nena naagees; nagaray nena haarana koyees; neni iza xoonana bessees» gides.
Hessafe guye Qayeeley ba isha Aabeele, «Ane gede dembaso boos» gides. Biidi istti demban dishin Qayeeley ba isha Aabeele bolla dendidi wodhides.
GODAY Qayeele, «Ne ishay Aabeeli awan dizee?» gi oychchides. Qayeeley zaaridi, «Ta erikke; ta ishaa naagizay taneyee?» gides.
GODAY Qayeele, «Hessa ays ooththadii? Beya; ne ishaa suuththi biittafe pude taakko waassees.
Ne kusheppe ne ishaa suuththaa ekkidi mittanaas doona doyda biittaa bolla ha7i neni qanggettadasa.
Neni ooththiinkka biittay nees kath immenna; bete asa mala neni biitta bollan toylattana» gides.
Qayeeley GODAA, «Ne tana qaxxayiza qixaate tani mulekka dandaykke.
Hekko neni tana hach ha biittafe yedeththaasa; tani ne sinththafe qotettana; bete asa mala tani biitta bolla toylattana; tana demmiday oonikka wodhana» gides.
GODAY iza, «Nena oonikka wodhenna; wodhikko ne halo tani laappun kushe kessana» gides; hessa gishshas demmiday oonikka iza wodhontta mala GODAY iza bolla malata woththides.
Qayeeley GODAA sinththafe kezidi Edene baggafe arshey mokkiza baggara diza Noode
geetettiza biittan de7ides.
Qayeele Yeleta
Qayeeley ba machcheyra aqiin iza shaarada Heenooke yeladus; he wode Qayeeley katama giigsidi he katamaa ba naaza sunththan, «Heenooke» gi sunththides.
Heenookey Iraade yelides; Iraadey Mahuyaa7eele yelides; Mahuyaa7eeley Matusa7eele yelides; Matusa7eeley Laameeke yelides.
Laameekey Aadonne Xiilo geetettiza nam7u machcheta dawuth ekkides.
Aaday Yaabaale yeladus; Yaabaaley mehe haarishe yuuyi yuuyi dunkaanen diza asata aawa.
Iza ishaa sunththi Yuubaale; Yuubaaley qasse diith diixxizanne susul7e punniza asata ubbata aawa;
Xiilay qasse Tubaaliqayne geetettiza naa yeladus; Tubaaliqayney xarqimalappenne biratappe dumma dumma miishshata qoxxizaadde. Tubaaliqayne michcheya Naa7imo geetettawus.

Issi gallas Laameekey ba machcheta, «Ta machcheto Aadee, Xiilee siyite! Ane tani yootizayssa ezgite. Issi asi tana wadhdhi madunththida gishshas tani iza wodhadis; ee, tani he tana madunxissida wodallaza wodhadis.
Qayeele halo kessanaas laappun kushe koshshiko Laameeke halo kessanaas laappun tammanne laappun kushe koshshees» gides.
Seetenne Heenoose
Addaamey ba machcheyra aqiin hara naa yeladus. Yelada «Qayeeley wodhida Aabeele gishshas Xoossi taas hara naa immides» gashe iza Seete
gaada sunththadus.
Seeteykka attuma naa yelidi iza, «Heenoose» gi sunththides. Asay he wode GODAA sunth xeygidi goyno oykkides.

footnotes.text: Qayeele: Qayeele guussi Ibraaweta qaalan, «Qayin» geetettees. Birsheththayka, «Demmadis» guussa.
Seete: Seete guussi Ibraaweta qaalara immides guussa
